questions.stem: A 52 years old man complains of dryness of the mouth. On examination he lack salivary secretion from the Parotid gland. This indicates a lesion of which of the following nervous structures?
questions.stemHtml: A 52 years old man complains of dryness of the mouth. On examination he lack salivary secretion from the Parotid gland. This indicates a lesion of which of the following nervous structures?

options.label: B
options.text: Chorda tympani in the middle ear cavity
